info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Drops-v2-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Drop Management API enables users to retrieve information about students who have dropped their education enrollments. This API provides insights on enrollment trends, allowing educational institutions to identify patterns and make informed decisions. Typical consumers include academic administrators and data analysts who are interested in tracking enrollment changes over time. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their understanding of student engagement and retention strategies.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to drop an enrollment from the system. Ensure that the enrollment ID is valid and that the enrollment can be dropped based on current policies.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters required for dropping an enrollment. Please ensure that all mandatory fields are correctly populated before sending the request.
